meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给已拍好的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加与转录同步的设计图形卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引语、侧栏、画中画等;原片在下面原样播放,最终渲染成 MP4,画布可选 16:9、9:16 或 4:5。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”、“package my video” 等词时触发;它不做普通字幕(那是 /embedded-captions),意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这个访谈视频加图形卡片:标题、数据标注、引语,做成 9:16。
say.note: 先转录,再逐张设计卡片

say.text: 帮我给这段播客视频包装,加下三分之一和数据侧栏,画布 16:9。
say.note: 原片原样播放,卡片叠在上面

say.text: 把这段口播里的关键数字做成数据标注卡片,用暗色主题。
say.note: 卡片数量由时长和密度推算

howto.what_en: Layers timed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP — onto an existing talking-head or podcast clip, synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas. The clip plays untouched; output MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not for plain subtitles (use /embedded-captions); unclear intent → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards — titles, data callouts, quotes — to this interview as 9:16.
say_en.note: Transcribes first, then designs each card.

say_en.text: Package this podcast clip with a lower-third and a data side panel, 16:9.
say_en.note: Clip stays untouched; cards layer on top.

say_en.text: Turn the key numbers in this talking head into data-callout cards, dark theme.
say_en.note: Card count follows length and density.
